title: This Fish Stays Warm in Water Near Freezing
subject: Atlantic bluefin tuna

scenes.text: This fish feeds in near-freezing water and stays warm as a mammal.
The Atlantic bluefin tuna. It hunts in water around 37 degrees Fahrenheit.
Its body stays near 77 to 80 degrees, far warmer than the sea around it.
It can weigh up to 1,500 pounds and grow ten feet long.
Tags showed some cross the Atlantic and back in a single year, diving over 3,000 feet.
A warm body in a cold ocean is how a fish crosses an ocean twice.

description:
This fish feeds in near-freezing water and stays warm.
The Atlantic bluefin tuna holds its body near 77 to 80 degrees and can cross the Atlantic and back in a year.
Would you rather be warm-blooded or cold-blooded?
